caption: The drawing features a single object centered on a light beige or off-white background. The object depicted is a rooster figurine standing on a rounded pedestal base. The rooster has a red comb on top of its head, a yellow beak, a brownish face and neck, and a faint black dot for the eye. The wing and tail feathers are a mix of green and red with darker outlining, while the body is primarily brown. The base is painted in shades of tan and light brown with some darker areas to indicate shadows or contours. There is a small, neat signature or text near the base of the rooster toward the lower right, rendered in fine lines.
title: Chalkware Rooster
